_comment: The PR and push smoke selection (CI v5, docs/CI.md).
Every PR and every push runs ONE macOS job (ci.yml's `smoke`): it
builds once (UI tests included), then runs the `unit` tests below as one
xcodebuild invocation (no retry), and on a push the `ui` tests as one
invocation (one targeted retry), on the same build and booted simulator
(UI on pushes only: Eric, 2026-11-02). It answers 'does this build, and is
anything obviously broken?'. Every unit class, the timing families and the
complete UI suite run in the nightly workflow (nightly.yml, shaped by
scripts/hosted-suite.json), which also validates a release.
Rules for this list - the SIZE rule is the important one:
- pin single tests, Class/testMethod, never whole classes. A class
grows with every test anyone adds to it: from 2026-10-18 to 10-29 the
seven curated classes went from about 500 tests to 680 and unit smoke
from 195 s to 240 s while this list stayed the same. A pinned list
grows only when someone edits it.
- max_unit_tests and max_ui_tests cap the lists; plan-tests.py smoke
fails a PR that goes over. Replace a test rather than add one; raising
a cap is a deliberate change with its reason in the PR. The merge
gate's job is a fast verdict on a shared runner pool, not coverage:
the nightly run is the exhaustive authority.
- ONE area per class (see docs/CI.md for the mapping), a few of its
core paths each; the UI pair are the setup wizard and the profile
cards, without the slowest walks (the LAN credentials walk took 150 s
and the photo control 68 s), which run nightly.
- never add the nightly-only timing families (hosted-suite.json
nightly_only_unit) - they run with repeats at night and must not
re-litigate on every PR (plan-tests.py smoke fails a pinned one);
- every test here must exist in the right target: scripts/plan-tests.py
smoke fails otherwise, so a rename cannot silently shrink PR coverage.
Two additions join the same unit invocation (no extra fixed cost), as
whole classes:
- source_contracts: static source scans that a PR breaks without
touching them (a new unlabelled icon button, a logger on the wrong
subsystem). They take seconds; before 2026-10-22 they failed only at
night, after the PR had merged.
- the PR's own unit classes: plan-tests.py smoke --changed-from adds
every unit class declared or extended in a changed ConduitTests file,
and <Stem>Tests for a changed app file <Stem>.swift, cheapest first
within changed_budget_s of baseline time (scripts/test-timings.json;
a class with no baseline counts 3 s). Left-over budget goes to the
stem's family, <Stem><Topic>Tests (AppState.swift reaches
AppStateChatResumeTests). A changed class runs whole, in place of its
pinned tests. Most red nightly runs 2026-10-19..24 were tests a PR
added or edited, or a family member of the file it changed, that
never ran before merge. Timing families are never added.
changed_max_classes keeps the invocation within nightly's batch of 45.
